regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow and consolidating: only 5 of 17 themes are trend-eligible, and the top of the board is not crowded (no crowding flag on Banks, Energy, or High-Dividend Blue Chips). Banks lead with modest durability, Energy is the closest challenger with the healthiest trend structure (durability_bar 0.8, breadth 0.9), and tech/consumer/gaming dominate the bottom — a classic value-over-growth, financials-and-resources complexion. Momentum is a focus lens only; the trend gate is the one validated control, and it has helped here (gate_helps true).
emerging_watch: Watching whether Energy (H-shares) can overtake Banks as the confirmed leader: the observable condition is Energy's durability_bar holding above 0.75 while Banks' breadth falls below 0.5 — a confirmed handoff, not a prediction.

theses.thesis: Energy has the strongest trend-health signature on the board: eligible, durability_bar 0.8 (highest), hurst_tag 'trend', and breadth 0.9 (near-universal participation). It is the confirmed challenger behind Banks, uncrowded (crowding_z 0.24), and the trend gate that is the only validated edge supports staying with an intact, broad uptrend rather than trading the headline leader. This is a durability/breadth case, not a rank case.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: A second eligible trend with solid breadth (0.75) and durability_bar 0.65, uncrowded (crowding_z 0.05), and structurally a defensive-income complex in a market where lower-board tech/gaming carry negative momentum. The trend gate argues for staying with intact, low-vol uptrends; dividend blue chips are the classic beneficiary of exactly this rotation.
theses.dissent: Rising global yields or a HK rate-tightening cycle would compress the dividend-yield appeal and turn this into a value trap; the theme is a slow-grinder, not a momentum leader.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips loses eligibility and its breadth drops below 0.5 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: The only scorable China-tech proxies sit at the very bottom of the board with negative scores and poor trend health. Platform Megacaps have durability_bar 0.18, breadth 0.111, and hurst_tag 'mixed' — no trend eligibility, no breadth, no staying power. In a market where the validated trend gate is the edge, an avoid lean on a broken-down, non-eligible theme is defensible as size-down/discipline rather than a directional short.
theses.dissent: China platform names are deeply oversold and carry high beta to any policy-turn or AI/tech sentiment spike; a sharp rebound could outpace the low-beta themes.

falsifier.text: China Platform Megacaps regains trend eligibility and posts a positive 10-day return above the Hang Seng benchmark.
